title: Variations of Demushkin Groups that are not Absolute Galois Groups
summary: We construct two families of examples of pro-p groups, with rather elementary presentations, that do not complete into 1-cyclotomic oriented pro-p groups. These provide brand new examples of pro-p groups that do not occur as maximal pro-p Galois groups of fields containing a root of unity of order p - and thus, as absolute Galois groups.
